units.title_form: Plans, free time and social arrangements
units.title_target: Planes, tiempo libre y acuerdos sociales

learning_objectives: Can describe a daily morning routine using present simple.
Can describe getting ready to go out using present simple.
Can ask and answer questions about daily schedules using present simple.
Can talk about household chores using present simple.
Can talk about daily obligations using have to.

lessons.title_target: Describiendo lo que está pasando ahora
learning_objectives: Can describe current actions using present continuous.
grammar_focus: present continuous: affirmative for current actions

learning_objectives: Can talk about future plans using going to.
grammar_focus: going to: affirmative for future plans

learning_objectives: Can describe a regular past activity using the past simple.
Can describe a past activity using past simple with was/were.

lessons.title_target: Describiendo un lugar en el pasado
learning_objectives: Can describe a place in the past using there was / there were.

lessons.title_target: Hablando del fin de semana pasado
learning_objectives: Can describe past actions using past simple with regular verbs.
Can tell a short story using past simple with irregular verbs.
grammar_focus: past simple: irregular verbs (go, have, see)

learning_objectives: Can describe past actions that did not happen using past simple negative.
Can ask and answer questions about past events using past simple questions.
Can describe a sequence of past events using past simple and time markers.
grammar_focus: past simple: irregular verbs (go, have, see)

learning_objectives: Can write a short message about a past experience using past simple.

lessons.title_target: Haciendo planes para el fin de semana
learning_objectives: Can ask and answer questions about weekend plans using present continuous for future arrangements.

lessons.title_form: Inviting a friend to an event
lessons.title_target: Invitando a un amigo a un evento
learning_objectives: Can make and respond to invitations for social events.

lessons.title_target: Sugiriendo actividades para el tiempo libre
learning_objectives: Can make suggestions for free time activities using 'How about + -ing?'.

lessons.title_form: Talking about future plans with 'going to'
lessons.title_target: Hablando de planes futuros con 'going to'
learning_objectives: Can describe future plans and intentions using 'going to'.

lessons.title_form: Discussing options and deciding what to do
lessons.title_target: Discutiendo opciones y decidiendo qué hacer
learning_objectives: Can discuss options and decide what to do next using simple questions.
Can explain a simple communication problem and ask for repetition.
Can ask for and provide contact information in a simple exchange.

lessons.title_form: Discussing plans and making decisions together
lessons.title_target: Discutiendo planes y tomando decisiones juntos
learning_objectives: Can exchange information and discuss what to do next in a simple cooperative task.

lessons.title_form: Booking a room at a hotel
lessons.title_target: Reservando una habitación en un hotel
learning_objectives: Can ask for and provide simple information about room availability and prices at a hotel.

lessons.title_form: Checking in and out of a hotel
learning_objectives: Can check in and check out of a hotel using simple phrases and questions.

lessons.title_target: Preguntando por las instalaciones del hotel
learning_objectives: Can ask and answer simple questions about hotel facilities and services.
Can ask for and understand simple directions to the airport and other places.

lessons.title_form: At the airport: check-in and security
lessons.title_target: En el aeropuerto: facturación y seguridad
learning_objectives: Can handle check-in and security procedures at the airport using simple phrases.
Can understand and communicate simple information about flight delays and cancellations.

lessons.title_form: Finding your way around the airport
lessons.title_target: Encontrando el camino en el aeropuerto
learning_objectives: Can ask for and understand simple information about gates, platforms and routes.
Can describe simple geographical features and places using basic adjectives and phrases.

lessons.title_form: Looking for a product in a store
lessons.title_target: Buscando un producto en una tienda
learning_objectives: Can ask for a product in a store using 'I'm looking for...'.
Can identify the location of a product in a store.
grammar_focus: present continuous: affirmative for current actions (review)

learning_objectives: Can ask the price of an item using 'How much does it cost?'.
Can state the price of an item using 'It costs...'.
Can ask to try on clothes in a store.
Can describe how clothes fit using 'too big', 'too small' and 'just right'.
Can use short comparative adjectives to describe products.
Can identify the best option among several products using superlative adjectives with 'the -est'.
Can express that something is the best using 'the best of all'.
Can ask about payment methods at the checkout.
Can state a preference for paying with cash or card.
Can ask if there is a discount on an item.
Can ask for a refund politely.

lessons.title_form: Handling a problem with a purchase
lessons.title_target: Manejando un problema con una compra
learning_objectives: Can explain a problem with a purchase in simple terms.
Can write a short message to request a refund or exchange.

lessons.title_target: Hablando de las partes del cuerpo
learning_objectives: Can name and point to basic body parts.
Can describe common physical symptoms and feelings using basic vocabulary.
Can give simple advice about health problems using 'should'.

lessons.title_form: Asking for medicine at the pharmacy
learning_objectives: Can ask for medicine and describe symptoms at a pharmacy.
Can express obligation related to health routines using 'have to'.
Can express simple health rules and prohibitions using 'mustn't'.

lessons.title_form: Making polite requests with could and may
lessons.title_target: Haciendo peticiones corteses con could y may
learning_objectives: Can make polite requests for help or permission in health situations.

lessons.title_form: Describing a health problem in detail
lessons.title_target: Describiendo un problema de salud en detalle
learning_objectives: Can describe a health problem and give a few relevant details.
Can describe their job and workplace using simple sentences.
Can name common job titles and work-related objects.
grammar_focus: present simple: affirmative with be and have

learning_objectives: Can describe their work schedule using time expressions.
Can state their working hours and days off.
Can describe their current studies and educational background.
Can name school subjects and academic levels.
Can describe their skills and qualifications using simple sentences.
Can state their work experience and abilities.
Can discuss job requirements and obligations using 'have to'.
Can ask and answer questions about what is necessary for a job.
Can use comparatives to describe different jobs and study options.
Can express preferences between two options.
Can express the best option among several using superlatives.
Can give a simple reason for a choice.

lessons.title_form: Writing a short message about work
lessons.title_target: Escribiendo un mensaje corto sobre el trabajo
learning_objectives: Can write a short message describing their job or studies.
Can use connectors like 'and', 'but', 'because' to link ideas.
grammar_focus: present simple: affirmative with be and have

learning_objectives: Can describe the environment and name common environmental problems.
grammar_focus: present simple: affirmative with be and have

lessons.title_form: Describing what we can do to help
lessons.title_target: Describiendo qué podemos hacer para ayudar
learning_objectives: Can discuss simple actions to help the environment.

lessons.title_target: Expresando obligación de proteger la naturaleza
learning_objectives: Can express obligation to protect nature using 'must'.
Can give simple advice about recycling using 'should'.
Can name common everyday technology and describe its use.
Can ask for help with everyday technology using 'how' questions.
Can use quantifiers to describe technology and nature.

lessons.title_form: Writing a short message about the environment
lessons.title_target: Escribiendo un mensaje corto sobre el medio ambiente
learning_objectives: Can write a short message about the environment using simple sentences.
grammar_focus: present simple: affirmative with be and have
